metadata.case_name: LI XIAO YOU v. FUGRO GEOTECHNICAL SERVICES (HK) LTD & OTHERS

plaintiff.education_level: Graduated from the Geological Training College at Guangzhou; had commenced further study for a degree

source: he sustained a fracture of the 5th thoracic vertebra and a burst fracture of the 12th thoracic vertebra

injuries.description: burst fracture of the 12th thoracic vertebra
source: he sustained a fracture of the 5th thoracic vertebra and a burst fracture of the 12th thoracic vertebra
together with multiple rib fractures and haemopneumothorax

injuries.body_part: right brachial plexus / right upper arm
source: and a right brachial plexus injury
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple nerves at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: total paralysis of his lower limbs
source: The injuries resulted in total paralysis of his lower limbs, loss of feeling from his nipples downwards, and weakness in his right upper arm.
He is permanently wheelchair-bound and cannot stand or walk unaided.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of thoracic spinal cord

manifestations.description: total paralysis of his lower limbs
loss of feeling from his nipples downwards
weakness in his right upper arm
permanently wheelchair-bound and cannot stand or walk unaided
some pain in his right shoulder, particularly when pushing his wheelchair along
has to support himself when sitting without back support
has some pain in his back
suffers involuntary spasms of the lower limbs
has to use a catheter and suppositories to evacuate his bladder and bowels
some constriction in his chest and breathing difficulties on exertion
psychiatric disorders and depression which require counselling
able to feed himself, but not cook
can transfer himself in and out of his wheelchair, manoeuvre it on the flat, and bathe himself, although he often needs assistance when he is ill, and for some movements he finds difficult

treatments_received: inpatient care at Queen Mary Hospital (three months)
rehabilitation at Maclehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre (nine months)
Chinese doctor treatment: stretching, vitamin injection and acupuncture
attendance at Chung Shan Hospital for emergencies
regular follow ups and urological tests including urine tests, urodynamic tests, kidney scans
treatments_future: continuation of Chinese doctor treatment (stretching, vitamin injection, acupuncture)
attendance at Chung Shan Hospital for emergencies (e.g. urinary tract infections)
regular examination at Guangdong Province Medicine Hospital
urological follow-ups in Hong Kong including urine tests, urodynamic tests, kidney scans

losses.description: Paralysis of lower limbs; loss of feeling from nipples downwards; weakness in right upper arm; impotence; urinary and bowel incontinence.
Permanently wheelchair-bound; cannot stand or walk unaided.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life

losses.description: Often needs assistance when ill; employs a domestic helper and assisted by his brother on a full-time basis.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Able to feed himself but cannot cook; requires assistance for some movements and tasks.
Little expectation of any permanent personal relationship nor family of his own.
Ended his prospects of marriage to a Ms Ye Li Hua (Yip Lai Fa).

losses.category: Loss of ability to pursue education
losses.description: The accident ended his chances of completing his university education.
Total loss of earnings and no realistic prospect of obtaining work in the future.

losses.category: Loss of holidays or special occasions
losses.description: Increased costs of holidays because he will require assistance and the help of a carer or companion.
psychiatric disorders and depression which require counselling
